feeds.title: EZZ Life News
feeds.description: EZZ Life Science Holding Limited is a genomic life science company with a mission to improve quality of life and human health. It focuses on research and development to address four key health challenges - genetic longevity, human papillomavirus, helicobacter pylori, and weight management.

feeds.description: Keep updated with the latest news and information from the WA Life Science Industry. With a prosperous start-up scene, world-class infrastructure and a pipeline of research providing a strong supply of opportunities, Western Australia's thriving life sciences industry deliver innovation and excellence globally.
